output.reason_for_conversation: understanding treatment options and regaining agency in medical decision-making
output.summary: User was told to switch from infliximab to Humira after four years without options discussed, and felt dismissed when asking questions. The bot validated the anger, explained alternative biologic classes (Stelara, Entyvio) and their mechanisms, highlighted the importance of drug-level and antibody testing to guide the choice, and helped draft questions for the next appointment. User confirmed they felt heard and had a concrete plan to take back to their consultant.
